The correct count is 6 × 10 = 60 handshakes, since each witch shakes hands with each of the 10 sorcerers, and each handshake is a distinct (witch, sorcerer) pair.

The proposed solution divides by 2 and gets 30. That is wrong. The counts of "handshakes involving a witch" and "handshakes involving a sorcerer" are two ways of counting the same set of 60 handshakes. They are not two separate sets that overlap, so there is no double-counting to correct. The final answer of 30 is incorrect.
